```{r}
igv_dep <- htmlDependency(
  name = "igv",
  version = "2.15.5", # Use the latest stable version
  src = c(href = "https://jsdelivr.net"),
  script = "igv.min.js"
)
```



```{r, results='asis',fig.align='center'}
# Define your genomic tracks and configuration
igv_config <- list(
  genome = GenomeFasta,
  tracks = list(
    list(
      name = "Putative Venom sequences",
      format = "bed",
      url = Bed,
      indexed = FALSE
    )
  )
)

# Create the HTML structure
igv_widget <- tagList(
  div(id = "igv-div", style = "padding-top: 50px;"),
  tags$script(HTML(sprintf("
    var igvDiv = document.getElementById('igv-div');
    var options = %s;
    igv.createBrowser(igvDiv, options)
      .then(function (browser) {
        console.log('IGV Browser created');
      });
  ", jsonlite::toJSON(igv_config, auto_unbox = TRUE))))
)

browsable(attachDependencies(igv_widget, igv_dep))

```
